content:
Maya Patel: Quick follow-up from the morning event - auth refresh storm caused downstream 502s from model-registry in us-central. Need owners for hotfix + short-term guards.
Ajay Singh: saw the traces. pattern = many 401->refresh attempts clustered in <30s. retry amplification hit the registry.
Kevin O'Connor: vendor (AuthCorp) applied a temporary throttle window for 48h; requested mitigation plan and logs. I've opened ticket AUTH-3301.
Maya Patel: proposed immediate mitigations: increase local token cache TTL 60s->240s, add 300-1000ms jitter, and per-subject refresh dedupe. Low-risk config change.
Ajay Singh: I'll push a one-line config change to secrets-agent and add `auth.refresh_dedupe_hits` metric. Canary in 1h.
Kevin O'Connor: I'll own vendor follow-up + legal loop for SLA addendum. If no vendor response in 48h, escalate.
incidents-bot: Task created: "Auth refresh hotfix" assigned to Ajay Singh. Due 24h.
Maya Patel: short-term owners/timeline recap: Ajay (hotfix + metric) 24h, Maya (runbook & alert) 7d, Kevin (vendor + SLA) 48-72h.
Ajay Singh: ACK, starting canary deploy now. Will report canary metrics in-thread.
Maya Patel: Thanks. Add any blockers here. :eyes:
